prompt.project_info: Luxury fashion editorial portrait in a minimal white-paneled interior with deep burgundy eveningwear and a flowing train.
prompt.main_subject: Clearly adult fictional woman with dark loose updo, face-framing strands, luminous realistic skin, soft glam makeup, and confident poised gaze; deep burgundy halter dress with secure coverage, elegant side shaping, and a sheer chiffon train layered over an opaque underdress, gold hoops, bangles, and ivory pointed heels.
prompt.composition_elements: 4:5 full-body portrait, low seated fashion pose with one knee lifted, one hand near shoe and one at hip, polished floor and white paneled wall, train visible.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft high-end beauty lighting, clean highlights, elegant shadow falloff, subtle film grain, refined confident mood.
prompt.technical_specs: 85mm portrait lens, shallow depth of field with face and outfit sharp, editorial-crisp fabric and jewelry detail.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Luxury 4:5 fashion editorial portrait of a clearly adult fictional woman with dark loose updo and soft glam makeup, seated in a poised low fashion pose in a minimal white-paneled interior, wearing a deep burgundy halter evening dress with secure coverage, opaque underdress and chiffon train flowing onto polished floor, gold hoops and bangles, ivory pointed heels, soft beauty light, 85mm portrait lens, subtle film grain, no text or logos.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, transparent dress over bare body, sexualized pose, child, teen, ageless person, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, plastic skin, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, logo, text
